provenance.notes: Datasets of kind 'simulated' are gpu_stack heatwave simulator output (scenario sim_v3) (not measured). Hardware: Google Colab CPU runtime, High-RAM shape, 8 vCPU (lead rerun on sim-scenario-v3 with the ETS guard). Timestral zero-shot weights from the Hugging Face hub.

protocol.metrics: WQL = 2*mean pinball(21 levels)/mean|y| (ratio of window means); MASE = mean over windows of MAE(median)/in-context seasonal-naive MAE; MAE of median; coverage of the 10-90% (cov80) and 1-99% (cov98) quantile intervals

classical.seasonal-naive: season = SEASON[scale], quantiles from in-sample seasonal-naive errors
classical.ets: statsforecast AutoETS (shared ETSForecaster, unrestricted model choice), season = SEASON[scale]
classical.ets-flat: statsforecast AutoETS restricted to additive error, no trend (ANN; ANA at hourly scale)
classical.arima: statsforecast ARIMA(2,1,1); hours: seasonal (1,0,0) with season 24

protocol.timestral: zero-shot, no covariates, V=1 per series; 209M on an equally spaced subsample of windows
